channel.title: Financial Conduct Authority - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Financial Conduct Authority (fca.org.uk)

item.title: Timing of the FCA's motor finance announcement
item.description: We will set out our approach on motor finance redress shortly after markets close on Monday 30 March, having consulted on a compensation scheme in October 2025.

item.title: FCA highlights risks when dealing with unregulated lenders
item.description: We are reminding regulated firms they need to undertake proper checks when dealing with unregulated lenders, safe custody providers, money brokers and financial leasing companies – also known as 'Annex 1' firms.

item.title: Investigation into Market Financial Solutions Limited
item.description: We have opened an enforcement investigation into Market Financial Solutions Limited (MFS).

item.title: How technology is changing the pensions conversation
item.description: Speech by Nikhil Rathi, FCA chief executive, at the JP Morgan Pensions and Savings Symposium 2026.

item.title: FCA orders Beauforce Corporation to stop operating and return client money
item.description: We have restricted Beauforce Corporation Limited from carrying out any regulated activities. This means it cannot provide regulated debt advice or debt management services to consumers.

item.title: FCA confirms new incident and third party rules to bolster resilience
item.description: We’ve confirmed new rules to make existing incident and third party reporting clearer, more consistent, and easier for firms to follow.

item.title: Creating a redress system that works better for consumers and firms
item.description: We’ve reached a significant milestone in our joint work with the Financial Ombudsman Service and the Government to modernise the redress system so that consumers get fair outcomes quicker and firms have greater clarity about how issues will be handled. We’re delivering change at speed by acting now within our current powers, with a focus on improving how the system works in practice. item.title: FCA bans Kasim Garipoglu from working in UK financial services
item.description: Kasim Garipoglu has been banned from working in UK financial services. The FCA found he is not fit and proper because of his lack of honesty and integrity.

item.title: Concept Capital Group update: administrators appointed
item.description: On 9 March 2026, the High Court placed Concept Capital Group (CCG) into administration. BTG are the administrators of the company.

item.title: Second charge mortgage firms told to raise standards for consumers
item.description: Lenders and brokers in the second charge mortgage market need to consider how they advise customers, assess affordability and charge fees.
